name: morse-room
description: A local receiving-only Morse code trainer with lessons and custom practice.

scripts.dev:chat: npm run build && wrangler pages dev public --d1 DB=morse-room-chat-local --binding SITE_URL=http://localhost:8788 --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/state --compatibility-date 2026-10-11
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
